title.original: Framing AI System Benchmarking as a Learning Task: FlexBench and the Open MLPerf Dataset
title.zh: 将人工智能系统基准测试作为一项学习任务：FlexBench和Open MLPerf数据集
title.en: Framing AI System Benchmarking as a Learning Task: FlexBench and the Open MLPerf Dataset

inclusion_reason.zh: FlexBench 与 Open MLPerf Dataset 将可配置执行、完整元数据和开放结果库组合为持续演进的系统基准基础设施。
inclusion_reason.en: FlexBench and the Open MLPerf Dataset combine configurable execution, complete metadata, and an open result corpus into continuously evolving benchmark infrastructure.

abstract.zh: FlexBench 将 AI 系统基准视为持续学习的数据任务，而非一次性排行榜。它扩展 MLPerf LLM 推理流程、接入 Hugging Face，并把模型、软件、硬件与准确率、时延、吞吐、能耗和成本元数据汇入开放 MLPerf 数据集。
abstract.en: FlexBench treats systems benchmarking as a continuously learnable data task rather than a static leaderboard. It extends MLPerf LLM inference with Hugging Face integration and collects model, software, hardware, quality, latency, throughput, energy, and cost metadata into an Open MLPerf Dataset.

problem.zh: 传统基准更新速度落后于模型与硬件演进，且结果分散，难以支持面向本地资源、成本与 SLO 的部署和协同设计决策。
problem.en: Traditional benchmarks lag rapidly changing models and hardware, and fragmented results do not support deployment or co-design decisions tied to local resources, cost, and SLOs.

approach.zh: 作者构建模块化 MLPerf 扩展以快速替换模型和系统配置，并将每次运行的完整元数据沉淀为可协作扩展、可做预测建模的开放数据。
approach.en: The authors build a modular MLPerf extension for swapping models and system configurations, then persist complete run metadata as a collaborative dataset suitable for prediction and feature engineering.

system_design.zh: FlexBench 负责可配置执行和 MLPerf 兼容提交，数据层使用统一 schema 记录配置、指标与环境；开放数据集可反向训练模型，预测未测试组合的部署表现。
system_design.en: FlexBench handles configurable execution and MLPerf-compatible submission, while a common schema stores configuration, metrics, and environment; accumulated runs can train predictors for untested deployment combinations.

key_results.zh: 团队通过在通用服务器上提交 DeepSeek R1 与 LLaMA 3.3 的 MLPerf 推理结果验证了框架可行性，并展示数据可用于资源约束下的部署比较。
key_results.en: The concept is validated through MLPerf inference submissions for DeepSeek R1 and LLaMA 3.3 on commodity servers, demonstrating deployment-oriented comparison under real resource constraints.

limitations.zh: 开放数据的预测价值依赖持续贡献和严格元数据一致性；初始验证模型与设备范围有限，也无法消除不同提交者优化程度造成的偏差。
limitations.en: Predictive value depends on sustained contributions and consistent metadata; the initial model/device coverage is narrow, and differing submitter optimization effort can still bias the dataset.

notes.zh: 两款模型、通用服务器与 MLPerf 提交验证来自官方摘要；服务器配置、准确率/时延/吞吐/能耗/成本结果待全文审计。
notes.en: Two models, commodity servers, and MLPerf submission validation come from the official abstract; server configuration and quality/latency/throughput/energy/cost results await full-text audit.
